personen.description: Older adult woman, partly gray hair under a white veil, wearing a long blue robe over light clothing and sandals. She stands at the far left, leaning slightly forward with a gentle, pleased expression; one hand is extended toward the others and the other hangs near her robe.

Young adult man with short curly dark hair, no visible beard, wearing a light beige tunic and sandals. He bends over a large jar, pouring liquid from a brown pitcher with both hands, with his face directed downward in concentration.

Young adult woman with brown hair mostly covered by a pale headscarf, wearing a light beige tunic and sandals. She stands holding a brown pitcher against her body with both hands, looking to her right with a calm expression.

Young adult man with curly dark hair and a short beard, wearing a light beige tunic and sandals. He bends forward and pours liquid from a brown pitcher into a jar, holding the pitcher with both hands, with a focused expression.

Young adult woman with dark hair under a pale headscarf, wearing a light beige tunic and sandals. She holds a brown pitcher in both hands in front of her and looks toward the man on the right with a neutral, attentive expression.

Adult man with shoulder-length brown hair and a beard, wearing a white robe with a reddish-brown draped outer cloth and sandals. He stands at the far right facing the group, with one hand extended in a speaking or instructing gesture and the other resting by his side; his expression appears calm.
